job.titel: Lead Workday Order To Cash F/H
job.beschreibung:
Location: Europe (any country/city)
INTRODUCTION
Are you excited about supporting organizations in transforming their HR processes through next‑generation technologies? Put your expertise to work for the world’s largest independent technology services provider and become a key player as a Workday pioneer. We’re ready if you are.
DEPARTMENT OVERVIEW
The Accenture Workday Business Group is a leading global Workday partner with extensive experience delivering some of the most strategic Workday programs. We are also proud to advise and collaborate closely with our clients—from early strategic thinking through technology implementation and transformation, to support and operations.
To learn more about our practice: www.accenture.com/workday
ARE YOU INTERESTED?
Would you like to work with international, top-tier technology talent and contribute to large-scale projects for major global organizations?
At Accenture, you will have access to role-specific training for your functional lead position. You will begin with a structured training journey alongside your peers and participate in seminars across different countries. You will be prepared, equipped, and integrated into a strong network to take on challenging and rewarding projects.
We believe in inclusion and diversity and in supporting every individual holistically. Our core values are:
Stewardship, Best People, Client Value Creation, One Global Network, Respect for the Individual, and Integrity.
“Around the world, one thing is universally true of Accenture people: we care deeply about what we do and the impact we have on our clients and the communities where we live and work. It’s personal to each of us.”
— Julie Sweet, CEO of Accenture
What We Offer
Innovative, large-scale Workday projects
A global network of talented and passionate colleagues
Challenging engagements for some of the world’s largest companies
Extensive training programs and development opportunities
International career and volunteering opportunities
A diverse and socially responsible work environment
Flexible working hours and remote work options
A friendly, collaborative workplace
The opportunity to build your career in line with your aspirations
As a Workday Order to Cash Lead
You will be part of a consulting team that delivers far more than technology. From rapid deployments to full transformations, you will provide integrated, cloud-based ERP solutions that enable organizations to adopt more effective ways of working.
In this role, you will help clients maximize the value of their Workday investment by:
Leading and contributing to all phases of the Workday Order to Cash implementation lifecycle, including requirements gathering, design, configuration, testing, and deployment
Working with clients to understand business needs, translate them into Workday configurations, and provide expert guidance on best practices
Configuring Workday modules to meet business requirements related to financial accounting, statutory reporting, and country-specific needs in global Workday Financials deployments
Identifying strategies, risks, and options, and recommending approaches and mitigation plans to address functional and client requirements
Collaborating with cross-functional teams (finance, IT, project management) to ensure seamless integration of Order to Cash processes with other modules and systems
Providing guidance and mentoring to junior team members, sharing knowledge and best practices to support their development
Advising clients on industry standards and best practices
Presenting design options through prototyping
Understanding and applying Workday and Accenture Workday methodologies
Providing the project manager with progress updates and keeping them informed of overall project status
Demonstrating strong client and stakeholder management skills to achieve project objectives
Supporting innovation through the development of new methods and industry reference assets
Your Profile
Ideally, you have strong financial expertise and several years of experience on the Workday platform, either as a consultant or in a client role, leading and driving the Workday agenda.
You are motivated, solution-oriented, and able to work independently to find effective solutions. You have experience managing and communicating with a wide range of stakeholders. You are results-driven, persuasive, and able to confidently present and sell your ideas.
#LI-EU
We are looking for:
Workday Financials certification in Order to Cash. Additional Workday certifications are an advantage
Strong experience in financial transformation projects
Experience across multiple full-cycle Workday implementations
Solid understanding of Order to Cash processes and best practices
Fluent in English
Ability to meet client travel requirements when necessary and to effectively manage a virtual team as well as client interactions
Ability to thrive in a diverse and fast-paced environment
Strong analytical mindset with the ability to apply logic effectively to solve problems
Ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously and meet deadlines despite competing priorities
Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to collaborate with diverse teams
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain complex messages and requirements
Strong motivation to work closely with clients and deliver an exceptional client experience
What Will Set You Apart:
Fluency in any European Language
Additional Workday Finance certifications
About Accenture
Accenture is a leading global professional services company that helps the world’s leading businesses, governments and other organizations build their digital core, optimize their operations, accelerate revenue growth and enhance citizen services—creating tangible value at speed and scale. We are a talent- and innovation-led company with approximately 791,000 people serving clients in more than 120 countries. Technology is at the core of change today, and we are one of the world’s leaders in helping drive that change, with strong ecosystem relationships. We combine our strength in technology and leadership in cloud, data and AI with unmatched industry experience, functional expertise and global delivery capability. Our broad range of services, solutions and assets across Strategy & Consulting, Technology, Operations, Industry X and Song, together with our culture of shared success and commitment to creating 360° value, enable us to help our clients reinvent and build trusted, lasting relationships. We measure our success by the 360° value we create for our clients, each other, our shareholders, partners and communities.Visit us at www.accenture.com
